messages:
Jules K.: Quick sync  Vanguard reserved pool rehearsal tomorrow 08:00 PST. Need final confirmation on rate limits, autoscale knobs, and the spike script.
Aditya (CS): Confirmed on date. Do we have the final token budget from finance? I think they capped at 1.0M/day with a 25% burst window.
Hannah T.: Finance confirmed 1.0M/day burst_allowed=250k. We should gate long-running batch jobs during the first 24h.
Ravi Ops: Pool details: 20x A100s dedicated, allocator_mode=exclusive. I propose min_instances=1, scale_target_tps=800, max_instances=20.
Jules K.: Scale_target_tps 800 seems fine assuming prefix caching is warm. We'll need a priming script to prefill KV cache.
Aditya (CS): I'll coordinate customer to run prompt-primer at T-4h. Also request Vanguard to delay heavy reprocessing for 48h post-cut.
Hannah T.: Loadtest plan (3 stages):
1) Warmup 30m @ 25% load to prime KV/prefix.
2) Ramp 60m linear to target 100% steady-state.
3) Spike 10m at 400% then backoff.
Start laptops: use shadow routing for non-critical paths at 15%. Canary route 3% to new allocator.
Ravi Ops: Adding fallback route to q4_0-variant in routing policy. auto_fallback_enabled=true, mem_threshold=88%. Will commit after review.
Jules K.: Rate limiter rules: token_bucket refill=60000/min, burst=250k/day. Need to validate enforcement across proxies.
infra-bot: runbook:update vanguard-reserved -> revision 9 by Jules K. (1771000722)
Aditya (CS): Can we also test quota overcommit behavior? I want to ensure graceful 429s and helpful error bodies for the customer.
Hannah T.: Test case added: trigger 15% overquota and verify 429 + Retry-After header + user-friendly message.
Ravi Ops: Maintenance note: one node has a nvlink firmware mismatch; patch scheduled 01:30 PST. Should finish before rehearsal.
Jules K.: Okay. Action items: 1) Ravi finish patch + commit fallback route 2) Hannah run the 3-stage loadtest and post metrics 3) Aditya confirm primer run with Vanguard 4) I'll run pre-rehearsal checklist 30m prior.
Aditya (CS): I'll ping Vanguard and post confirmation in the runbook.
Hannah T.: Loadtest command ready:
```
rload --target https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate --clients 300 --duration 20m --shadow 15% --canary 3% --prompts vanguard_seed.txt
```
Hannah T.: I'll kick off warmup at 07:30 PST and tag @Jules K. in the results.
infra-bot: alert: scheduler -> node-patch started by Ravi Ops (1771003100)
Ravi Ops: Patch completed, node healthy, nvlink checks passed.
Jules K.: Great. Last reminder  add an emergency fallback policy: region-failover -> us-west-2 -> route to shared-fallback pool.
infra-bot: reminder: pre-rehearsal checklist due in 30m (1771003200)
Aditya (CS): Noted. Will be on standby for any customer questions.
Jules K.: Thanks team. If anything flares, escalate to #oncall and DM me. :rocket:
